result.markdown:
# Automation and Power Platform consultants for an Adelaide manufacturer

For your situation, I would shortlist consultants who can **automate order processing, digitise shop-floor data capture and integrate with your existing ERP** — rather than firms whose primary offering is replacing your ERP or installing factory machinery.

The important distinction is that you have two connected challenges\:

- **Business-process automation\:** turning customer purchase orders, emails, PDFs and approvals into validated ERP transactions.
- **Manufacturing operations\:** capturing production quantities, downtime, quality checks, traceability and shift information, then connecting those records to the ERP.

Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI may be a good fit for the first challenge and parts of the second. Direct machine, PLC or SCADA integration may need a specialist industrial automation partner as well.

## My recommended shortlist

These are the firms I'd approach first, based on their publicly described capabilities and Adelaide presence or Australian delivery coverage. This is a capability-based shortlist, not a claim that each has completed your exact project.

![CODIUM - Showcase SA](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RF_tfOT1xxAfIk2ejgYNdvm7yL58hBSqS3lUpC1oaaYHNH5fM-euIbthi7TGZeEh-CKgEm6EscgVMNxkCwci981836GeqIrTgaW7rdN7sK0eRt6g9eN4OH3icnglXiMnsaKvathlpm4EV9HEbGXyjsY7te076_--LCvZxPD5Em3itL-S0EOgu0MaaOSx0F4P?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Codium

(Strong local manufacturing fit)

Codium describes manufacturing solutions spanning work orders, bills of materials, supplier workflows, quality checks, production visibility and ERP/accounting integration. It also has an Adelaide-built garment-tracking case study using RFID and mobile apps. [www.codium.com.au](https://www.codium.com.au/industries/manufacturing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why speak to them\:** If your processes don't fit standard Power Platform templates and you need bespoke shop-floor applications that work around your current ERP.

**Ask\:** Can you deliver the first version using Power Apps and Power Automate, or would a custom web/mobile application be more suitable?

Website: [codium.com.au/industries/manufacturing](https://www.codium.com.au/industries/manufacturing)

Unit 3/97 Pirie St, Adelaide SA 5000, Australia

## How I'd prioritise the first meetings

| Your main priority | Speak to first |
|--------|--------|
| Power Platform apps and Microsoft workflow automation | Office Experts Group, Inturing |
| Manufacturing workflows and bespoke shop-floor apps | Codium, Novark Labs |
| Orders arriving as emails, PDFs or spreadsheets | EITSAA, Inturing |
| Complex ERP integration or legacy systems | Codium, AWLabs |
| Machine-level production data and SCADA | ATSYS or SAGE Automation, paired with a software integrator |


## What I'd ask every consultant to demonstrate

Ask for a short discovery engagement and a proof of value using one real production workflow. Before committing, establish\:

1. **ERP integration\:** Which supported API, connector or integration method will be used? Can the solution work without replacing the ERP?
2. **Order automation\:** Can it extract order lines from customer PDFs, validate prices and stock, flag exceptions and create ERP orders without duplicates?
3. **Shop-floor capture\:** Can operators record quantities, scrap, downtime, quality results and job completion on tablets, with timestamps and traceability?
4. **Reliability\:** What happens when the ERP is offline, an order fails validation or a transaction is submitted twice?
5. **Ownership\:** Will you receive the source code, Power Platform solutions, documentation, deployment process and ongoing support?
6. **Commercial model\:** What are the implementation cost, ongoing support charges, Microsoft licensing requirements and expected payback?

I'd specifically request a demonstration of **one customer order flowing from receipt through validation into your existing ERP**, followed by a production-status update from the shop floor. That single demonstration will reveal a lot about the consultant's integration capability.

## One question that would help me narrow this down

**Which ERP are you currently running?** For example, SAP Business One, Pronto, Epicor, MYOB Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics, or a custom/legacy system.

The ERP name will materially change which two or three consultants I'd recommend contacting first, because connector support, APIs, licensing and integration experience are often the deciding factors.

[www.awlabs.com.au](https://www.awlabs.com.au/industries/manufacturing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why speak to them\:** If your existing ERP has limited integration capabilities or you need a more engineered integration layer than low-code workflows alone.

[Website: awlabs.com.au/industries/manufacturing](https://www.awlabs.com.au/industries/manufacturing)

## If shop-floor data includes machines and PLCs

Power Platform is well suited to operator forms, inspections, approvals and dashboards. If you also need to capture machine states, cycle counts, production-line signals or SCADA data, consider a specialist such as one of these alongside your software consultant.

items.markdown: ## How I'd prioritise the first meetings

| Your main priority | Speak to first |
|--------|--------|
| Power Platform apps and Microsoft workflow automation | Office Experts Group, Inturing |
| Manufacturing workflows and bespoke shop-floor apps | Codium, Novark Labs |
| Orders arriving as emails, PDFs or spreadsheets | EITSAA, Inturing |
| Complex ERP integration or legacy systems | Codium, AWLabs |
| Machine-level production data and SCADA | ATSYS or SAGE Automation, paired with a software integrator |

items.markdown:
## What I'd ask every consultant to demonstrate

Ask for a short discovery engagement and a proof of value using one real production workflow. Before committing, establish\:

1. **ERP integration\:** Which supported API, connector or integration method will be used? Can the solution work without replacing the ERP?
2. **Order automation\:** Can it extract order lines from customer PDFs, validate prices and stock, flag exceptions and create ERP orders without duplicates?
3. **Shop-floor capture\:** Can operators record quantities, scrap, downtime, quality results and job completion on tablets, with timestamps and traceability?
4. **Reliability\:** What happens when the ERP is offline, an order fails validation or a transaction is submitted twice?
5. **Ownership\:** Will you receive the source code, Power Platform solutions, documentation, deployment process and ongoing support?
6. **Commercial model\:** What are the implementation cost, ongoing support charges, Microsoft licensing requirements and expected payback?

I'd specifically request a demonstration of **one customer order flowing from receipt through validation into your existing ERP**, followed by a production-status update from the shop floor. That single demonstration will reveal a lot about the consultant's integration capability.

## One question that would help me narrow this down

**Which ERP are you currently running?** For example, SAP Business One, Pronto, Epicor, MYOB Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics, or a custom/legacy system.

The ERP name will materially change which two or three consultants I'd recommend contacting first, because connector support, APIs, licensing and integration experience are often the deciding factors.
